subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. It was great to walk through the Redwood inference demo with you and the team. As promised, attached is a concise POC/assessment outline to help structure the evaluation and make it easy for you to measure success. High-level recap and proposed plan below.

Quick demo recap:
- Showed generation latency and throughput on our Dedicated config (A100-equivalent).
- Walked through streaming + function calling example for your customer-response use case.
- Validated that prefix caching could reduce token cost for repeat prompts in your workflow.

Proposed 3-week POC (scope & success criteria) — see attached PDF for full details:
1) Scope:
   - Integrate Redwood hosted test endpoint (dedicated test pool) with a subset of your staging traffic (synthetic + 2 production-like flows).
   - Run evaluation on your sample prompts and 1k historical conversations (redacted).
   - Verify integration patterns: streaming, function calls, and embedding-based reranking.
2) Success criteria (pass/fail metrics):
   - Latency: p95 generation latency <= 350ms for median prompt length (as measured by Redwood telemetry).
   - Cost: token cost per session <= target (we'll use baseline numbers in the outline).
   - Quality: human review — >= 80% pass on the 100-example blind review set from your team.
   - Reliability: error rate < 0.5% over test volume.
3) Timeline (target):
   - Week 0 (this week): finalize scope, NDAs/POC SOW, and data sharing method.
   - Week 1: integration + sample uploads; initial smoke tests.
   - Week 2: scale tests, quality evals, iterate prompts/configs.
   - Week 3: final report, handoff recommendations, next-step proposal.
4) Owners:
   - FinServCorp: Priya Shah (evaluation lead), Alex Johnson (sponsor)
   - Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE, program lead), Dev Patel (SE, integration/ops), Rachel Kim (customer success)

Immediate next steps:
- Review the attached POC outline and confirm Priya (evaluation lead) and procurement contact for the SOW.
- If happy, we can send a short POC SOW and a test account by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments:
- FinServCorp_POC_Outline_v1.pdf (POC scope, objectives, telemetry plan)
- Demo_recording_20270412.mp4 (full demo recording)

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min sync to walk the outline with Priya and your engineers.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132

--
Redwood Inference
Making inference predictable and economical for production teams
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservcorp.com>

Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finservcorp.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

Marissa —

Appreciate the recap and the quick turnaround on the outline. A few clarifying items from our side before we kick off:

1) Data: we'll provide a redacted 1k-conversation sample and a small evaluation set (100 examples) — Priya will own the uploads. Are there size limits for the test endpoint?
2) Security: can you confirm that logs from the POC will be retained for 30 days and that we can restrict access to a small list of Redwood users? We may need a short exceptions doc for our InfoSec.
3) Cost: curious how you measure token cost in the report — is it based on raw tokens generated/received or on billed units?

Priya — looping you in as the evaluation lead. Priya, can you confirm you can start week-of Apr 19? If so, procurement will need a one-page SOW and a short order (or PO) to get the test account unlocked. procurement@finservcorp.com is on the thread.

Assuming answers to the above, we'd like to proceed. Please also include any recommended test dataset format and a secure upload link.

Thanks,
Alex
VP Product — FinServCorp
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservcorp.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks — quick answers to your questions:

1) Test endpoint & data limits: the demo/test dedicated pool supports uploads up to 5GB for datasets. For evaluation, a 1k-record JSONL (each line: {id, prompt, expected_response, metadata}) works great. If you need us to accept CSV, we can convert on our side.

2) Security / logs: by default POC logs are retained 30 days. Access can be limited via a short ACL we control on the account; we'll only grant access to the named Redwood SE and CSM (me + Rachel Kim). If you need an audit export, we can provide a daily S3 log export for the period of the POC.

3) Cost reporting: our POC report uses raw token consumption and maps it to estimated billed units using the exact model/config used during the run — we'll include both raw tokens and estimated $ to make it transparent.

Action items for integration (I can help own these):
- Provide secure upload link for sample dataset (I'll generate a presigned S3 URL once we have NDA/POC SOW).
- Provide sample ingest script and a Postman collection for the test endpoint.
- Schedule a 30-min integration kickoff with your engineers (suggest Wed Apr 21 or Thu Apr 22).

I've attached a short checklist and the sample ingest script link: https://drive.redwood.ai/finservcorp/ingest-samples

Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through the upload process.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai
